name: How do I maintain and seal bathroom marble after it is installed?

mainEntity.name: How do I maintain and seal bathroom marble after it is installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintain newly installed marble by cleaning it with pH-neutral, stone-safe cleaners and a soft microfiber cloth. Avoid bleach, vinegar, ammonia, or standard tub-and-tile cleaners, as their acids instantly etch and dull marble. Squeegee shower walls and glass after use to reduce water spots and soap scum buildup. Depending on household shower use, reapply a quality penetrating stone sealer every 6 to 12 months. Test the seal periodically by dropping water on the stone; if the water absorbs and darkens the marble rather than beading up, it is time to reseal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clean surfaces with pH-neutral stone cleaner, squeegee water after showers, and reapply an impregnating stone sealer every 6 to 12 months.
